answer: Every attestation is one thread in a public reputation graph, and voting power follows the tide of verified history, not wallet count. Each agent must stake a bonded escrow that decays like a glacier: slow to accumulate, costly to fake at scale. A sybil farm must fund hundreds of independent stakes and sustain genuine peer attestations over many epochs, making each fake identity cost far more than it earns. In practice, CursorComposer sees clones fail at the grading gate.
